title: Otter.ai Review (2026): Honest Take for Small Business Owners
meta_description: Plain-English Otter.ai review for small business owners: what it does, what it costs, what the free plan gets you, and what you miss.
summary: Otter.ai is the free tool that turns your Zoom or phone calls into written notes so you don't have to type them. Hate writing notes after customer calls or meetings? It hands you a transcript and a short summary. Rarely on calls? Skip it.
good_for: Get a written record of a customer call without typing.
Catch what was said on a Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet call.
Pull out action items so nothing gets forgotten.
Search old conversations for what a client said.
Record an in-person job walkthrough and turn it into notes.
Share a clean summary instead of a long email.
how_to_use:
1. Go to otter.ai and sign up free.
2. Connect it to Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet (or open the app and hit record on your phone).
3. After the call, open the transcript and use the AI chat: "Give me a short summary and list the action items from this call."
what_youll_get: A written transcript and a short summary with action items in a few minutes. Works best on clear audio with one or two people. Free handles short calls; longer meetings and more minutes cost money.
missing: Free (Basic) is 300 minutes a month, cuts any single meeting off at 30 minutes, and gives 20 AI chat questions a month.
Pro is $16.99/month, or $8.49/month billed yearly (1,200 minutes, up to 90 minutes per meeting). Business is $30/month or $24/month yearly.
Accuracy drops with heavy accents, background noise, or people talking over each other.
Recording other people? Check your state's consent laws first.
Still not a lawyer. Double-check anything that costs you money or binds you.
verdict: Open this one when you need notes from a call and don't want to type them. Use free for short customer calls; pay only if you keep hitting the 30-minute wall.
price_free: Basic: $0. Joins Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet; 300 minutes a month; 30 minutes per meeting; 20 AI chat questions a month; 3 lifetime file imports.
price_paid: Pro $16.99/month, or $8.49/month billed yearly (1,200 min/month, 90 min per meeting). Business $30/month or $24/month billed yearly. Enterprise through sales. Yearly discount is for first-time subscribers.
